chat_messages.text: How would you set up a Bayesian framework for evaluating a job-training program?
Start with a prior over the treatment effect informed by past program evaluations, then update with your outcome data...
What priors are defensible when past evaluations disagree?
You can use a hierarchical prior that treats past studies as draws from a distribution of effects...
How do I communicate posterior uncertainty to policymakers?
Report credible intervals alongside the probability that the effect exceeds a policy-relevant threshold...
What's the difference between Louvain and Leiden for clustering a citation graph?
Leiden fixes Louvain's badly-connected-communities problem and guarantees well-connected partitions...
How should I pick the resolution parameter?
Sweep it and look for a plateau in partition stability across random seeds...
Can I combine it with spectral methods?
Yes — spectral coordinates of cluster centroids give you a low-dimensional map of how communities relate...
Should journals allow LLMs to draft referee reports?
The core tensions are confidentiality of the manuscript, accountability for judgments, and homogenization of standards...
What would a disclosure policy look like?
Reviewers could declare tool use and attest that judgments are their own, similar to conflict-of-interest statements...
Is there empirical work on detection?
There are studies estimating the share of AI-generated text in reviews via stylometric shifts after ChatGPT's release...
How does differential measurement error bias treatment effect estimates in survey experiments?
If the error correlates with treatment assignment, the bias can be in either direction and standard errors understate uncertainty...
What designs mitigate it?
Multiple measures per construct, anchoring vignettes, and validation subsamples with gold-standard measurement...
Any estimators that model the error directly?
Errors-in-variables and MIMIC-style latent variable models are the usual starting points...
